title: Fold the Total
goal: Summarize numbers into a tuple using fold.
hints: fold takes an initial accumulator seed and passes it into the closure on each step.
The closure must return the next accumulator value. Block statements that do not return a value evaluate to unit and break the type check.
explanation: fold threads an accumulator through every element. The closure receives the current accumulator and must evaluate to the next accumulator value. Using map fails with E0061 because map takes only a closure. Statement blocks that update variables in place evaluate to unit. This fails with E0308 because fold expects a tuple.
